Edit by hand or with hindcast_dropin.py, then run build_pages.py. image: path under site/pages (null = placeholder box). text: 2-3 short lines (empty = placeholder). results.rows: [metric, fnam, nam, gfs, gfs06, within-gate]; null cells print as pending.

cases.title: CAD ice storm
text: Freezing rain and sleet cover 295k km² at f39, the same as the NAM; the sub-freezing wedge is 393k km² against the NAM’s 397k.
Gate: pass. The soil fix took this case’s 2 m temperature error against the NAM from +0.42 K to +0.04 K.

cases.title: Snowcrete
cases.when: 5 Jan 2025, Washington DC, snow to sleet
text: Snow, sleet and freezing rain pattern at f21 as before: 130k, 66k and 16k km² against the NAM’s 153k, 41k and 45k. By f36 it is snow in both.
Gate: pass. The pattern is the NAM’s, with a little more sleet and less freezing rain.

cases.title: Gulf Coast snow
text: Heaviest 24 h snow is 32.2 cm at f30, heavier than the NAM’s 23.6 cm, and 20.9 cm at f42, lighter than its 23.6 cm.
Gate: pass on features. This case has the largest 2 m temperature gap (+0.20 K) and a dry dew-point bias (see the dew-point note below).

cases.title: PNW bomb cyclone
text: The low is 946.9 hPa at f12 and 954.1 at f24, about 6 and 4 hPa weaker than the NAM’s 941.0 and 950.3. The track is within 0.2°.
Gate: partial. The low is too weak and mountain precipitation is drier; the dew-point dry bias is largest here.

columns: Measure, 12-84 h, CONUS, five cases pooled
